verdict.summary: Structural home one-run adjustment ADOPTED (constant home-share α = 0.744, fit on pooled +1): the tie mass resolves to ±1 home-weighted and +1 is now calibrated (pred 17.4% vs actual 17.4%), line −1 compresses to |Δ| ≤ 0.001 pooled, and p_home_win_derived lands at ~0.53 vs actual ~0.53 (fixing the NB moneyline home-edge underweight). Totals byte-identical; per-line 3-way sums to 1.0. Residual: the within-away split (pred −1 12.2% vs actual 10.8%); P(≥2)/P(≤−2) are already raw-calibrated.
evidence: structural fix applied: the impossible raw tie mass (P(margin=0) = 0.1017) now RESOLVES to margin = ±1 home-weighted with share 0.744 (P(+1)' = P(+1) + α·P(0), P(−1)' = P(−1) + (1−α)·P(0), P(0)' = 0); every other margin stays at its raw full-basis value. Persisted P(margin=0) = 0.0000. The old proportional renormalization (2531462) inflated P(≥2) 0.3583→0.3989 (the +4.1pt line −1 over); that is why the tie mass now resolves to ±1 instead of spreading.

+1 band now CALIBRATED: pred 0.1740 vs actual 0.1740 (delta -0.0001); −1 pred 0.1217 vs actual 0.1082 (delta -0.0135). The residual within-away split (±1 vs ≤−2 pooled) is small; the +1 target match is exact on pooled.

line −1 gate (regenerated run_line_calibration record): home cover Δ +0.0002 (calibrated); +1 band pred 0.1740 vs actual 0.1740; −1 band pred 0.1217 vs actual 0.1082 — all seven run lines pass the |Δ| ≤ 0.02 gate on pooled.

correlation: actual Pearson rho(home_runs, away_runs) = -0.009 — essentially ZERO, so positive cross-team correlation is NOT the driver (a copula at rho=0.30 would reproduce the symmetric ±1 mass 0.4473 vs actual 0.2821 only by narrowing the margin spread, which the data independently wants). The mechanism is under-dispersed margins plus the home one-run edge (now structurally added).

sum-vs-difference: max |P(total=t) pred-actual| = 0.0191 — totals are roughly calibrated (byte-identical under the margin fix); the corrected +1 is a DIFFERENCE-side structural term, not a per-team-sum change.

total-dependence: after the +1 resolution the largest per-bucket P(margin=+1) gap is 'mid' (pred 0.140 vs actual 0.108); close to calibrated. The constant home-share α = 0.744 is fit pooled; per-total variants were ablated (see margin_adjustment_ablation_20260829.json) and rejected for negative per-game probabilities at the high bucket.
